help.ROOT:
Usage: memory [options] [command]

MemoryJS - Knowledge Graph CLI

Options:
  -v, --version             Output the current version
  -s, --storage <path>      Path to storage file (default: "./memory.jsonl")
  --output-format <type>    Console output format (json|table|csv) (default:
                            "json")
  -q, --quiet               Suppress non-essential output
  --verbose                 Enable verbose/debug output
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  entity                    Manage entities (create, read, update, delete)
  relation                  Manage relations between entities
  search [options] <query>  Search entities and observations
  observation               Manage entity observations
  tag                       Manage entity tags and aliases
  hierarchy                 Manage entity hierarchy (parent/child relationships)
  graph                     Graph algorithms (shortest path, centrality,
                            components)
  import [options] <file>   Import data from file
  export [options] <file>   Export data to file
  stats                     Show knowledge graph statistics
  archive [options]         Archive old or low-importance entities
  compress [options]        Find and merge duplicate entities
  validate                  Validate graph integrity
  interactive|i             Start interactive REPL mode
  exclude                   Manage do_not_remember exclusion rules
  decision                  Manage decision-rationale records (ADR-equivalent)
  project-context           Manage structured per-project knowledge
                            (facts/conventions/commands/glossary)
  tool-affordance           Inspect per-tool rolling outcome statistics
  smoke [options]           Run a per-category end-to-end smoke test (~30 ops)
                            against a fresh temp graph
  diag                      One-shot diagnostic snapshot: memoryjs version,
                            runtime, storage, env
  env [options]             Print all memoryjs env vars with documented defaults
                            and resolved values
  health                    Run fast integrity checks (graph loads, distinct
                            names, no orphan relations, no hierarchy cycles)
  version                   Compact version line: memoryjs, node, platform
  show <entity>             Verbose snapshot of one entity (observations,
                            relations in/out, tags, hierarchy, timestamps)
  tree [options] [root]     Hierarchy tree from a root entity (or all roots when
                            omitted)
  neighbors <entity>        Incoming + outgoing relations of one entity (with
                            in/out degree counts)
  size                      Graph size + storage footprint summary
                            (entity/relation/observation counts, file bytes,
                            line count)
  heuristic                 Manage condition→action heuristic guidelines (add,
                            match, reinforce, conflicts)
  obs-dedup                 Cross-entity observation duplicate detection (exact
                            and Jaccard similarity)
  spell                     Spell-suggest queries against the graph vocabulary
  check [options]           Detect orphan relations + missing parents +
                            hierarchy cycles. Dry-run by default.
  cache                     Inspect or bust the per-tier search caches (basic /
                            ranked / boolean / fuzzy)
  reindex [options]         Rebuild search-side indexes (TF-IDF/BM25 ranked +
                            spell vocabulary).
  audit                     Query the audit trail (provenance): filtered log,
                            per-entity history, chain verification, stats
  doctor [options]          Preflight checks for documented gotchas: node
                            version, sqlite driver, workers build, storage file,
                            env lint, embedding provider
  help [command]            display help for command

help.audit log:
Usage: memory audit log [options]

List audit entries with filters (default: aligned lines; --json for piping)

  --entity <name>  Filter by entity name (exact match)
  --op <type>      Filter by operation type (choices: "create", "update",
                   "delete", "merge", "archive")
  --agent <id>     Filter by agent/user identifier
  --since <time>   Only entries at/after this time (ISO 8601, or relative like
                   "2h", "7d")
  --until <time>   Only entries at/before this time (ISO 8601, or relative like
                   "2h")
  --text <substr>  Case-insensitive free-text match over serialized entries
  --limit <n>      Keep only the most recent N matches
  --file <path>    Audit log file (overrides MEMORY_AUDIT_LOG_FILE and the

  --json           Emit entries as JSON
